summary: Post-refactor regression pass on Lakeview Burgers & Seafood. Backend monolith (server.py 1085L) was split into 14 modules (config, models, seed_data, auth, 9 routers, thin 69L server.py). All 123 existing pytest tests in test_api.py + test_cleanup_p0_p1.py PASS (up from 122/123 in iteration 7 — the Bearer-token logout bug is now fixed). All routes preserved, /api/status still 404, session survives backend restart, no _id leaks, auth protects admin endpoints (401 without token). Frontend: home page loads, desktop + mobile nav (incl. new Catering link), dashboard login works, new PWA Installs KPI card renders on Analytics tab.
critical_code_review_comments: Refactor is clean: server.py now 69 lines, individual router modules well-scoped. Passes 700-line guideline easily.
All prior issues from iteration 7 have been addressed — Bearer-token logout now works (verified: verify returns 401 after logout with Bearer token).

Recommendation (non-blocking): tests load REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from env. Consider adding a conftest.py that reads /app/frontend/.env via python-dotenv so pytest works without manually exporting env vars.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Reused TEST_* records created in prior iterations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend refactor verified zero-regression. server.py is now a thin bootstrap, /app/backend/routers/ holds cms, specials, analytics, giveaway, loyalty, messaging, catering, newsletter, misc. /app/backend/auth.py holds verify_session + auth router. Pytest env requirement: must export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<frontend .env value> before running, or tests will fail with 'MissingSchema'. All 123 tests pass and all UI elements verified: nav-about/specials/menu/catering/contact (desktop + mobile variants), mobile-menu-toggle, analytics-pwa-installs card on dashboard. PWA install prompt (data-testid=pwa-install-prompt) only fires when browser raises beforeinstallprompt event, which did not trigger in headless Chromium — not a bug, expected behavior.
rca of the issue: No issues found. Iteration-7 logout bug (Bearer token ignored) is fixed — verified end-to-end: login → logout with Authorization: Bearer → GET /api/auth/verify now returns 401.
